name: Call Method
description: Calls a bundle outside this canvas: stdlib, a module, or hand-written CFEngine.

parameters.name: bundle_name
parameters.label: Bundle name
parameters.help: A bundle that already exists elsewhere — CFEngine's standard library, a cfbs module, or one you wrote by hand — e.g. "default:my_bundle". Without a namespace it's looked up in default. Canvas blocks call each other automatically; this isn't for that. Takes no arguments.
